articles.headline: Girls' basketball recruiting: College comps for 2027, 2028 risers
articles.description: Expect a major splash from these 2027 and 2028 recruits who remind us of some big-name college players.

images.name: Brieana Brown [1296x729]
images.caption: Expect to see Brieana Brown ranked in the class of 2027, after proving herself through the summer and fall and playing a game that brings to mind Gabriela Jaquez and Sahara Williams.

images.name: Syniah Coachman [1296x729]
images.caption: Class of 2027 riser Syniah Coachman's combo guard skills bring to mind those of current college stars Bailey Maupin and Tajianna Roberts.

images.name: Maliya Hunter [1296x729]
images.caption: Maliya Hunter has developed her game in highly competitive environments -- at Archbishop Mitty High School as well as with Jason Kidd Select.
images.credit: Courtesy of Archbishop Mitty High School

images.name: Jaylah King [1152x648]
images.caption: A riser in the class of 2028, Jaylah King has been a key to the success of Bishop McNamara (Md.) this season.

images.caption: Marlee Coleman's development arc mirrors that of USC's Kara Dunn and NC State's Khamil Pierre.
